thread:
Maya: heads-up — today's toolkit12 canary is triggering init failures on ~8 nodes in us-west2. Containers hit CrashLoopBackOff during init. Suspect rtld/soname ordering or gcc ABI mismatch from the image build.
Sam: which nodes and images exactly? can you paste the init logs?
Maya: node gpu-uw2-07 init logs (snippet):
```
/var/log/pods/.../init-container.log: /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2: symbol lookup error: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1: undefined symbol: _ZTISt9exception
nvidia-container-runtime-hook: error: failed to set up container: exit status 127
```
Liam: that looks like C++ RTTI symbol missing — usually a libstdc++ soname / GLIBCXX mismatch. what driver version are those nodes on?
Maya: nodes report Driver Version: 525.105.17 (nvidia-smi). Image was built from cuda:12.1 with a gcc13 overlay layer.
Anika: quick mitigation options: block cuda12 images in us-west2 via admission webhook, or cordon and rollback nodepool. we can also add an admission check for images that bundle host-linked libcuda.
Sam: also seeing ldconfig/ld.so warnings in kubelet: 'ld.so.preload: cannot find /usr/local/lib/something' — might be rpath ordering with nvidia hook. deploy-bot, did the runtime hook change recently?
deploy-bot: nvidia-container-runtime-hook v1.5.3 rolled at 2754995000, no hook config changes detected.
Ops-Sophie: i can cordon gpu-uw2-05..12 and drain non-critical workloads. do we want a temp isolation?
Liam: before cordoning everything, repro on one node:
```
sudo systemctl restart docker\ndocker run --rm --gpus all --entrypoint /bin/true myorg/cuda12-custom:2026-03-18
```
Maya: tried that on gpu-uw2-07, same error. interestingly it succeeds if we nsenter the container namespace and set LD_PRELOAD to host libstdc++.so.6 (hacky but confirms symbol search ordering).
Anika: :thinking_face: this suggests symbol resolution is preferring host libs over container rpath (or vice versa) during the init hook. short-term: pin workloads to cuda11 images or rebuild containers with bundled libstdc++. long-term: adjust hook to prefer container lib paths and document kernel/soname compatibility.
Sam: ops impact: rolling back to cuda11 loses some kernel/ptx perf optimizations — roughly ~2% inferred token-cost increase for a typical batch workload. retagging/rolling ~1200 containers across clusters will take ops time.
Ops-Sophie: i can run a controlled retag in us-west2 at 02:00 UTC tonight. plan: cordon affected nodes, drain, retag service manifests to cuda11-retro, smoke test, uncordon.
Maya: action plan for now: 1) cordon affected nodes, 2) full repro attempt (nsenter) on one node to gather better traces, 3) if repro stands, schedule rollback window tonight. i'll open a follow-up incident and add logs.
Sam: also adding a console probe to search kubelet logs for 'rtld symbol lookup' and 'nvidia-container-runtime-hook: error' so we get alerting if new nodes start flapping. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-0785 (linked).
Maya: thanks all, will post updates in the incident thread once we have repro traces and rollback ETA.
